changeNote: First complete 240-question assessment under the current 15 Values bank and scoring. Documented positions, user-authorised sound inferences and supported conditional neutral answers are distinguished. An independent evidence audit amended interpretation and source errors before archiving; substantive findings are recorded in review.notes. No 12Axes questions or scores were imported.

metadata.name: Vladimir Putin
metadata.description: Russian president whose current rule combines concentrated state power, the war in Ukraine, strategic economic direction and promotion of traditional social values.
metadata.scope: Current documented governing or campaigning position through 4 October 2026. Recent conduct is prioritised; earlier material is used only as a stated continuity-based inference. Party proposals are attributed as the leader’s endorsed programme, not implemented law. Every answer is an interpretive assessment, with lower confidence for biomedical hypotheticals and fine-grained psychological causation. No scores were targeted.

review.reviewer: Independent evidence audit — historical assessments agent
review.notes: Independent audit read all 240 exact questions, answer values and rationales, 15 evidence briefs and counter-evidence. Checked literal conditions, separate axis concepts, policy period and source applicability. Corrected regulated self-defence ownership versus carrying, religious influence versus formal doctrine and establishment, public broadcaster ownership versus independence, regional constitutions within national supremacy, and sex-role prescriptions versus causal beliefs. Added current tax and monetary-policy evidence; reduced an unsupported autonomous-targeting claim to an explicit conditional inference. Remaining low-confidence causal and hypothetical biomedical inferences are expressly provisional; neutral values represent a stated competing-principles judgement, not an unanswered item. Integration review by OpenAI Codex /root on 2026-10-04: portrait identity, local rendering, size and Commons attribution checked; the shared Image credits list includes this source. All 35 requested profiles were compared using calculated scores, with any resemblance at or above 95% explicitly reviewed against the named revision. Neutral-count warnings were retained only after the evidence review; they are not missing answers.
